# R packages the MLB test jobs need, one per line (blank lines and # comments ignored).
# Single-sourced here because .github/workflows/ci.yml both installs from this
# file and keys its package cache on its hash -- editing the list invalidates the
# cache automatically.
#
# THIS IS NOT renv.lock, ON PURPOSE. This repo does have a renv.lock for workstation
# reproducible builds, but the CI job disables the autoloader and installs from
# this list instead.
#
# Reason: renv.lock pins a large number of heavy dependencies. Installing directly
# via RSPM binaries on ubuntu-latest using setup-r and actions/cache is orders of
# magnitude faster, eliminates source compilations, and standardizes CI across
# NBA, NFL, WNBA, and MLB.
#
# Core packages required for MLB testthat suite and offline evaluation:
testthat
jsonlite
dplyr
tibble
duckdb
httr2
png
gifski
scales
ggplot2
mlbplotR
stringr
tidyr
DBI
